## First slide

```{r}
library(gganimate)
library(spatstat)
library(ggplot2)
library(gifski)

lambda = 300 # Poisson process intensity
nframes = 20

pois = lapply(1:nframes, \(iter) { 
  p = rpoispp(lambda)
  tibble::tibble(
    x = p$x,
    y = p$y,
    iter = iter
  )
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

gp = ggplot(pois, aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = 'steelblue4') +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  transition_states(iter)

animate(gp, fps = 1, nframes = nframes, rewind = TRUE,
        detail = 0,  width = 480, height = 480,  units = 'px')
```
